**Today I’m proud to endorse my friend Lee Reeves for State House in District 65. I put a lot of thought into this endorsement and don’t make this endorsement lightly. Some will ask why I’ve chosen to endorse Lee Reeves over Michelle Foreman as both would be conservative votes to represent our community. ** **
****For me it’s very simple, Lee embodies the thing I value most: Honesty. Years ago on a political issue, Michelle led me to believe something that wasn’t true and did the opposite. While I know she would be a conservative voter and appreciate that, I’d prefer the conservative representative who I can always count on to tell me the hard truth, good or bad and not just tell me what I want to hear while doing the opposite when I’m not around. That was the differentiating factor for me and I encourage people to vote for Lee so the conservative vote isn’t split between 2 people, leaving us without a conservative voice. ****It also gives me pause that Michelle ran twice for office in Nashville over the past 5 years, including in 2022. Now she’s moved to a friendlier conservative district all of a sudden and immediately wants to run for office. That doesn't sit well with me. Lee however is invested in the community already as Vice-Chair of the Franklin Board of Zoning Appeals. ** **
****As for the 3rd candidate in this primary, Brian Beathard, I couldn’t throw my support behind him because I don’t know him well enough to trust that he would vote in alignment with district 65’s conservative positions. Online you’ll struggle to find clear, solid positions from him on the issues that matter most to conservatives like education, illegal immigration impacting our communities, the economy and closing our open primaries. While I’ve heard he’s a nice man, it’s hard to pin down exactly where he stands on things. Brian has a history of voting both Democrat and Republican and holding office as an Independent while only recently holding office as a Republican. This also gives me pause because it typically means someone is riding two sides of the fence. ** **
****At the end of considering all candidates for District 65, I realized that there was one person who didn’t give me pause... That person is Lee Reeves and I believe he’ll be a solid conservative representative for District 65. I hope you put it in your calendar to vote for Lee during early voting or on Election Day August 1st!**** ** ** Robby Starbuck**

# In This Newsletter

1. Winning Not Whining
2. We Have Proof: Newly Registered Voter Campaign
3. Granny Caravan Kicks Off To Media Fanfare
4. The Race For Congressional Districts 4 and 5 Update
5. Potpourri: Pro Dems Stuff To Share

---
| | |
---
| | 1\. In Defense Of Our President: Winning, Not Whining
---
| | Imagine raising a child in a house where the only conversation is an obsession with an evil, corrupt person who inflicts pain and misery on others—and this is all they hear, which means it is all they know. There is no place in this house for stories about good, hope, and a better future, only fear. How do you think that child is going to turn out? What will their view of the world be? Let in stories of good, hope, and a better future, or you will manifest your destiny and theirs. We kicked off the [Pledge: Silence = Death](https://www.ruralamericansunited.org/so/54P0o4uJm/c?w=exyaxisd7Xx9rx_-sMU4woOjf3QhkBOBSQ-cOYXRJGM.eyJ1IjoiaHR0cHM6Ly93d3cucnVyYWxhbWVyaWNhbnN1bml0ZWQub3JnL2hvbWUvcGxlZGdlIiwiciI6IjY4MmZmZmRiLWNiMTgtNDg2MC05YmU4LWQxNTI0OGJhMDAzZiIsIm0iOiJtYWlsIiwiYyI6IjI3N2U3ZjRhLTAwZTMtNDhmYy1iYjk3LTY1NGIzZmEzNzRhOCJ9) last week, and thank you to the many people who have responded thus far. Now more than ever, our President needs our support, and the best and easiest way we can do this is by promoting pro-Democrat and pro-Biden information. We can no longer allow the media to profit by pandering to the lowest common denominator and glorifying the Republican opponent, MAGA, and its minions. To earn our marketing dollars and respect, they need to publish news that is worthy, reflective of the good work Biden and Democrats are doing, and engage in fair and accurate reporting. We ensure they do this by withholding our attention from scandalous posts, articles, and news programs, and by directing our subscription dollars, likes, comments, and shares to what is strengthening our country and building a future where we all thrive.
---
| |
---
| | Everywhere we turn, we see the need for us to do better in our management of the media. Last Sunday, while on the stairmaster at the gym, I watched Fox, Fox Sunday Edition, and CNN. Fox was defending Biden against the inaccurate portrayal of him in recent social media posts. Fox Sunday Edition criticized the congressional GOP for blocking Democratic-led legislation to bring ethics standards to the Supreme Court. However, CNN was a steady drumbeat of Trump, Trump, Trump... The Lincoln Project has become well known for their defense of Democratic values, and a person wrote to me saying I should follow their media posts because they "get it right." I looked at the last ten Instagram posts of the Lincoln Project, and every one of them was about Trump, Trump, Trump. Not a good word to be had for the good being done in our great nation by Biden and our Democratic leadership.
---
| | [](https://www.ruralamericansunited.org/so/54P0o4uJm/c?w=ZlxMNe2iEaqfYkHOUt-ptES5dJK-ik_i30gBBFWxd6s.eyJ1IjoiaHR0cHM6Ly93d3cucnVyYWxhbWVyaWNhbnN1bml0ZWQub3JnL3NvLzU0UDBvNHVKbT9sYW5ndWFnZVRhZz1lbiIsInIiOiI5OTU2MTNjMS04MTkwLTQxMzgtOTRkMS1iNjI2ZWNiMmM2MDgiLCJtIjoibWFpbCIsImMiOiIyNzdlN2Y0YS0wMGUzLTQ4ZmMtYmI5Ny02NTRiM2ZhMzc0YTgifQ)
---
| | [Harry Sisson](https://www.ruralamericansunited.org/so/54P0o4uJm/c?w=xhewEZhbFU4qhDmDkXWrT7DBjATeLl7KPVBdxNDaMrw.eyJ1IjoiaHR0cHM6Ly93d3cudGlrdG9rLmNvbS9AaGFycnlqc2lzc29uP190PThuSk80RXVzSDNTJl9yPTEiLCJyIjoiZDQ2ZjE4NzEtZTRmZi00OWIxLTg5NjgtY2IxODU5OTdlYThlIiwibSI6Im1haWwiLCJjIjoiMjc3ZTdmNGEtMDBlMy00OGZjLWJiOTctNjU0YjNmYTM3NGE4In0) is a name you might know, and if you don't, you should look him up. He is young and was one of the strongest proponents of Democratic action among social media influencers. He's been to the White House and recently received accolades from CNN for his work with the youth vote. When he started, he was all about supporting Democrats, but when Democrats switched from promoting Biden to bashing Trump, so did he. Now his feeds are almost exclusively about Trump, with barely a mention of Biden. Not even Biden’s well-paid campaign managers can find anything good to say about him. The Biden campaign is spending $50 million to launch advertisements, like this one, about—you guessed it—Trump. Team Johnny O

By Illinois Review
On Monday, over 100 grassroots conservatives gathered at the Drake Hotel in Oakbrook to meet legendary Republican strategist and political icon Roger Stone, who has served as a senior campaign aide to three Republican presidents – Richard Nixon, Ronald Reagan and Donald Trump – and hear his thoughts about the upcoming presidential election.

The event was hosted by Jim Pfaff, president of
The Conservative Caucus (https://www.theconservativecaucus.org/?utm_source=Illinois+Review&utm_campaign=6cf48b98be-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2023_10_30_09_24_COPY_01&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-8b40ac336f-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D) – the oldest national grassroots organization in the United States, with help from Illinois Review editor-in-chief Mark Vargas, and organized by grassroots leader Jacqueline Garretson Abene – was a fundraiser in support of TCC, as the group accelerates it’s national fundraising efforts and directs resources into key swing states ahead of the November election.

By Illinois Review

Late on Monday, the Illinois Republican Party State Central Committee – the governing board of the IL GOP, voted overwhelmingly to remove fellow SSC committeeman Mark Shaw as vice chair of the state party – in a stunning move – as the grassroots continue to show their dominance over statewide GOP politics.

name: Ami Bera
subject: a moment for reflection
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Bera for Congress
body:
|

Today, we pause to commemorate the ending of the institution of slavery in the United States on this solemn day.

Many Americans believe that slavery swiftly ended with the Emancipation Proclamation, but in reality, it took over **two years** for the news of freedom to reach every enslaved person in this country.

Freedom finally came when 2,000 Union Troops arrived in Galveston Bay, Texas to announce that the 250,000 enslaved people in the state were officially free by executive decree.

As we pause today to celebrate the freedom of the formerly enslaved peoples, we must not forget that there is still much more work to be done.

The systemic legacy of the institution of slavery is seen today and has only exacerbated issues in the Black American community. We see this through police brutality and the system of mass incarceration. That is why I have been committed to fighting against racial disparities and inequalities in Sacramento County and across the nation.

It is up to us, as a collective, to recommit to dismantling the structural inequities that exist as a direct result of our country’s long and painful history.

Be well,

Ami Bera

In the midst of a busy month on Capitol Hill, I'm dedicated to tackling the critical issues that impact you.

However, before sharing an update on recent legislative efforts, I must address a deeply disturbing incident unfolding.

A distressing news story recently surfaced - A migrant from NYC has been charged in the assault of a 13-year-old girl at Kissena Park (https://abc7ny.com/post/queens-rape-police-have-detained-person-interest-kissena/14969527/) . This abhorrent crime is reprehensible and yet another tragic result of Biden's open border policies. I will continue to do everything in my power to fight for a secure border, protect our communities, and prevent future tragedies.

Recently, local leaders, including myself, have united in protest against the proposed closure of Exit 114 on Route 17. This exit is a vital access point for residents, emergency services, and businesses in our area. The closure would not only inconvenience thousands of daily commuters but also potentially hinder emergency response times, putting lives at risk.

I am committed to advocating for practical solutions that serve the best interests of our community.

- Local leaders protest Exit 114’s proposed closure (https://www.scdemocratonline.com/stories/local-leaders-protest-exit-114s-proposed-closure,140321?fbclid=IwZXh0bgNhZW0CMTAAAR2w4fZtCknGUps-hp5GZWhb0dQcxNR9OVQ8HA5zRaSKyuJaXXOgSAIBwsU_aem_ZmFrZWR1bW15MTZieXRlcw)

I am advocating for a House field hearing on Governor Hochul’s decision to pause New York City’s congestion pricing plan.

This politically motivated delay not only creates a billion-dollar budget gap but also raises questions about the use of federal funds in the project. We must ensure transparency and accountability, especially when taxpayer dollars are involved.
- (https://spectrumlocalnews.com/nys/central-ny/politics/2024/06/11/molinaro-wants-hearing-on-congestion-pricing-pause?fbclid=IwZXh0bgNhZW0CMTAAAR0FzgxiGv30511Lt_WXipdbllJwPWZrxrjkSrJ6MVJ_jjL-zwHO-St5Biw_aem_ZmFrZWR1bW15MTZieXRlcw) Rep. I was proud to be the first Republican to back the Right to Contraception Act.

This bill is crucial and common sense in ensuring that everyone has access to contraception.

Just as I stood up for IVF (https://www.nbcnews.com/politics/congress/rep-marc-molinaro-becomes-first-republican-back-bill-protecting-ivf-rcna143301) , I will continue to fight for this key piece of legislation.

I am thrilled to announce that I have secured $5 million for critical infrastructure improvements on Henry Street in Binghamton.

name: Jill Stein
subject: Juneteenth is much more than a holiday. It’s a reminder of what we’re fighting for.
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Jill Stein for President 2024
body:
| | | [ ](https://www.jillstein2024.com/?e=e813143e1dc0d3b0ffcb007ffe357333&utm_source=jillsteinforpresident&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=juneteenth&n=1)
---
Peter

To many Americans, Juneteenth is a fairly new federal holiday. But the first celebrations of this extraordinary moment in American history took place 159 years ago.

In school we were all taught that “Lincoln freed the slaves.”

**Today we know the story did not end there, and that in fact the struggle for Black liberation is ongoing – and we each have a part to play.

** To put it simply, a debt is owed.

The historic crime of enslavement must be addressed beginning with a guarantee of reparations paid directly to the descendants of African slaves as an unequivocal human right.

**We don’t need any further debate on whether reparations should be paid.** **They should, without question** , as they were in 1988 to those impacted by WWII Japanese internment camps.

Yet just as the systemic oppression of Black Americans did not end with the legal abolishment of chattel slavery, reparations are merely the beginning – not the end – of the agenda we urgently need to embrace to facilitate Black liberation in America.

Civil Rights legend Fannie Lou Hamer famously said, _“Nobody’s free until everybody’s free."

_ Everything that Black Americans are fighting for aligns with the Green Party agenda and a progressive vision for our collective future.

**My administration will eliminate the cancer of white supremacy in our legal systems** by issuing an immediate moratorium on all proposed Cop Cities (ending all federal investment in such facilities), eliminating white nationalists from our police forces with federal oversight, establishing a National Office for Civilian Oversight of law enforcement, and creating a multi-agency task force for returning citizens to support the formerly incarcerated – just to name a few.

**We will expand our national historical and cultural understanding of Black history** by including race and ethnicity in all programs funded by federal dollars, increasing investment in Historically Black Colleges and Universities (HBCUs), and ensuring the Office of Civil Rights is fully staffed and funded.

**We will promote Black wealth, Black health, and Black lives** by investing in Black-owned businesses, ensuring single-payer healthcare addresses disparities for the Black community – particularly Black women. – and eliminate food deserts.

These are just a few of the policies we can and will implement under a Jill Stein administration. You can read more at [**jillstein2024.com/platform**](https://www.jillstein2024.com/r?u=Qj32F8ZTIcBOzthgR25-gF2J_V8cRlHgwGIBI_1lcLQ0Ce7w_K4rbPSVLguxOifF&e=e813143e1dc0d3b0ffcb007ffe357333&utm_source=jillsteinforpresident&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=juneteenth&n=2).

Our platform for Black liberation is the collaborative work of our extraordinary team and Black community members who are directly impacted by these issues in their daily lives. I am grateful for all the voices and experiences that contribute to our movement, and I am committed to seeing their experiences rendered into policy in the White House.

**To fulfill this vision and deliver a clear mandate at the ballot box this year, we need your support today. Please consider a contribution to support the team that brought our platform to life – and help us get this agenda on the ballot for EVERY American in November.**
---
| [](http://www.jillstein2024.com/?e=e813143e1dc0d3b0ffcb007ffe357333&utm_source=jillsteinforpresident&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=juneteenth&n=3 "DONATE") [DONATE](http://www.jillstein2024.com/?e=e813143e1dc0d3b0ffcb007ffe357333&utm_source=jillsteinforpresident&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=juneteenth&n=3)
---
For all celebrating today, I wish you a joyful Juneteenth. I am grateful for your partnership, and remain committed to full emancipation that stands the test of time.

In solidarity and gratitude,

Jill

name: Jennifer Boysko
subject: Wear sunscreen and vote Suhas
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Jennifer Boysko for Congress
body:
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/NGP/NGP50/1/102624/images/BoyskoForCongress_Logo_FINAL.png]
Dear Friends,
First, I extend my heartfelt congratulations to my colleague Senator Suhas Subramanyam on his impressive victory in the Democratic primary for Virginia's 10th Congressional District. Suhas ran a strong campaign, and I look forward to supporting him in the general election.
To all of our incredible supporters: thank you from the bottom of my heart. Your unwavering dedication to our campaign has been truly inspiring. To everyone who contributed financially, hosted events, knocked on doors, made calls, sent texts, stood out in the hot sun for hours on election day, and to all those who cast their vote for our campaign - I am forever grateful. Your commitment to our shared values is what keeps our democracy strong.
I know that some of you even came to our election night watch party with sunburns, a testament to your tireless efforts. Your passion and perseverance are admirable, and I am honored to have had you by my side throughout this journey.
One of my heroes, Mr. Rogers , once said, "There are three ways to ultimate success: The first way is to be kind. The second way is to be kind. The third way is to be kind." I am proud of our supporters and our campaign because we embodied this spirit of kindness. We never went low, and we never did anything we couldn't be proud of the next day. In fact, the best part of this effort has been seeing so many like-minded, kind-hearted, and hard-working people come together to demonstrate that politics can be better.
As we move forward, it is crucial that we continue to fight for the issues that matter most to our community and our nation. The road ahead may be challenging, but I have no doubt that together, we can make a difference.
In the coming months, Suhas will need our support as he takes on his Republican opponent in what could be a closer race than we've seen in recent years. Senator Tim Kaine , who has been a champion for Virginia, will also need our help to secure re-election. And of course, we must do everything in our power to ensure that President Joe Biden and Vice President Kamala Harris have the support they need to continue leading our country forward.
So, my friends, take a moment to recharge and heal those sunburns. Then, let's get back out there and continue the fight for a better future.
If I have any advice for all of you, it is this: wear sunscreen and support Suhas! Together, we can win in November and beyond.
With gratitude, resolve and as always –
my kindest regards,
Jennifer Boysko

body:

Hi Peter,
The Tennessee House Democratic Caucus would like to wish you a happy Juneteenth. This is a moment to acknowledge, celebrate, and reflect on the progress we have made towards a more equal and just society here in Tennessee and across the United States.
Juneteenth is also a solemn reminder of the grave injustices that Black Americans have faced throughout the history of our nation. The holiday has only recently received the recognition that it deserves, though it was on this day in 1865 when the final enslaved Americans found out that they were free. While Juneteenth was a turning point, the struggle for true equality for Black Americans continues.
Let us continue to march forward together toward a future where everyone is treated equally in the spirit of justice and dignity that Juneteenth embodies. Let’s reject hate and bigotry where we see it and stand up for what we know is right. With your support, we can ensure that we are moving in the right direction, always. Once again, Happy Juneteenth.
Tennessee House Democrats

As Co-Chair of one of the most important initiatives of the Republican Party, I wanted you to what we're doing right now to lay the groundwork for the biggest GOP landslide in AMERICAN HISTORY!

_**[A lot goes into building the most powerful election-winning machine our country has ever seen- so bear with me for a minute:](http://links.standingstrongamerica.com/u/click?_t=29c3b6e742c849fabbcc130432510e66&_m=1fb80abf978643379533c6914a805e5b&_e=-MXxyYrIsxMC92WYUxNSPCraDYTRdPPMywLotgBoRP5JpQgKyRYp7AH69OJUURz2aoXMvS342argnoCY4mX58dkcLpsxcXfdDA0jYIMYWGLGOBn6uL4hZ_xcYWEjXmKaPZfZAOHvj2YmLEvBjDCajE7eSUdMVhqyR0tvkMAPtIiZFjT4YudMEyDtOnwWjX_3DffUedibLu-HXofc1iV6w69Ss-qenCFe8pAH6u0xGq86Pc80HhEUhSEwp_l8br1hhipk9RMsV1CiMUQztrkmuO7dAO-I_FCOgN-cdqOopgml3HxrU_YQzaaka88QDcJnWF6fg9jXeB_6rms3xsnKyVk9CGtBUU44Q--sXygYTjAScskmbAMGD08JaxLVvsr73Seb8FPqe7m5hdZ2k6Un7A%3D%3D "A lot goes into building the most powerful election-winning machine our country has ever seen – so bear with me for a minute:")**_

-> If the Democrat Legal Machine tries any shenanigans, we'll be there to stop them
-> If Liberals can ballot harvest, we should ballot harvest even better
-> If they're sending poll watchers, we should send an army of our own
-> We're not pandering to minority voters, we're building relationships with them
-> We're expanding GOTV efforts to get young Conservatives to the ballot box
-> We're fighting bad election laws to make it easier to vote but harder to cheat

These are the nuts and bolts of winning campaigns up and down the ballot. And I'm proud to help lead these efforts.

As Conservatives, we have the issues on our side. We are the only commonsense Party. **If we get these campaign operations right, the Democrats are in serious trouble come election day.**

_But I have to be honest with you: building this level of infrastructure is very expensive._ We're running ads in costly swing-state markets, printing campaign literature, filling up gas tanks to knock doors, recruiting volunteers, and scaling up our voter contact programs.

And unlike the Democrats, we don't rely on Liberal billionaires and rich celebrities for funding.

I'm perfectly okay with that. But it means if we want to WIN BIG, the burden falls on all of us to step up. _**[That's why I'm coming to you now - would you be willing to pitch in a few bucks to help kick start these efforts? Hey there, can I share something with you?
When I came out in college, I knew I was interested in a career in public service. But I feared that I would have to face a serious choice between pursuing the field of my dreams or living my authentic life openly.
[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/87216748/480433052/-2013249406?amounts=250,100,50,25,5&refcode=jtk3995-bu-nd&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNDAvMS84ODI5OCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJjMzIxMTFhYS04ODJlLWVmMTEtODZkMi02MDQ1YmRkOWUwOTYiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=hXw4rPzy6gOvxCntknUGM0cAmekI0u0Ok41r86lPRPQ=)
After seeing others in the LGBTQ+ community demonstrate acts of courage by coming out, being themselves, and being public about who they are and who they love, I came to realize that I could do both:
**I could run for office and be honest about who I am — so that’s exactly what I did.**
When I became the first openly gay Senator elected in our nation’s history, I understood that I needed to use this extraordinary opportunity to make a difference in people's lives. From lowering prescription drug prices to protecting same-sex marriage through the _Respect for Marriage Act_ , I’ve worked hard every day since to do just that.
That's why I ran for office in the first place — not to make history, but to make a difference. And folks like you supported me because you wanted to make a difference, too.
[**I’m facing my most competitive and expensive reelection yet, so I can’t keep up this work without your help. | | Folks, on this Juneteenth, we remember the end of slavery and celebrate freedom. On June 19th, 1865, the last 250,000 slaves were declared free in Galveston, Texas. Only two years later, my great-great-grandfather was granted the right to vote. Sometimes it's hard to wrap my head around how much progress we've made in just a couple of generations. Three years ago, I had the honor of being at the White House when President Biden made Juenteenth a national holiday. It's truly surreal – knowing how far my family, and so many families of color, have come. All the way from being enslaved, to finally getting the right to vote, to being elected to represent the First State in the House, and running to become the fourth Black woman to serve in the U.S. Senate. We've walked down a long road of progress, but there's still more work left to be done to achieve racial justice and equity in our country. From working towards a fairer justice system to enshrining voting rights, I'm ready to create an even playing field for all Delawareans. So today, we celebrate how far we've come in our fight for racial justice and equality – and tomorrow we continue the fight. Thank you for taking a moment to reflect on Juneteenth with me. Onward, \- Lisa Blunt Rochester

| [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/87216875/480433519/-1295403277?refcode=AU_JH_CL_GEN_NOA_AC90_20240624_PM1_V1_S1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDMvMS82ODk4NiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJlZDc3N2UwZi04YTJlLWVmMTEtODZkMi02MDQ1YmRkOWUwOTYiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=zhowGQqNmOtky50wE_iD8NWQGr9kOAUoAymbKWYQ-14=&emci=63135461-832e-ef11-86d2-6045bdd9e096&emdi=ed777e0f-8a2e-ef11-86d2-6045bdd9e096&ceid=15529135) | Happy Juneteenth, friend. Today is a celebration of the significance of freedom. It is a commemoration of the progress our country has made. It is an acknowledgment of how far we have come since the end of the Civil War. President Abraham Lincoln signed the Emancipation Proclamation on January 1, 1863, but it was not until two and a half years later on June 19, 1865 that the news reached the enslaved people of Galveston, Texas. In the decades that followed, many states came to acknowledge the significance of June 19, and in 2021, I was proud to cosponsor and cast my vote in the House of Representatives to pass the _Juneteenth National Independence Day Act_ , sending it to President Biden’s desk, where he signed it into law and established Juneteenth as a federal holiday. As I cast my vote three years ago and reflect on the significance today, I fully appreciate how fragile our democracy is. We still have a long way to go, and the election this November will help determine our direction. We can’t change our past, but we can decide what kind of future we will pave for our children. clean_body: | | Happy Juneteenth, friend. Today is a celebration of the significance of freedom. It is a commemoration of the progress our country has made. It is an acknowledgment of how far we have come since the end of the Civil War. President Abraham Lincoln signed the Emancipation Proclamation on January 1, 1863, but it was not until two and a half years later on June 19, 1865 that the news reached the enslaved people of Galveston, Texas. In the decades that followed, many states came to acknowledge the significance of June 19, and in 2021, I was proud to cosponsor and cast my vote in the House of Representatives to pass the Juneteenth National Independence Day Act , sending it to President Biden’s desk, where he signed it into law and established Juneteenth as a federal holiday. As I cast my vote three years ago and reflect on the significance today, I fully appreciate how fragile our democracy is. We still have a long way to go, and the election this November will help determine our direction. We can’t change our past, but we can decide what kind of future we will pave for our children. So, as we reflect and rejoice on this special holiday, let us all take heart in its representation of the joy and resilience in our communities. Let us honor the contributions made on our collective path toward greater progress. I don’t know why things have slowed down so much, but if we miss another goal before a critical FEC deadline we are going to have to take a long, hard look at what we’re capable of doing with a reduced budget.
#

Peter, I wish I was writing under better circumstances.
My fundraising team just briefed me on our numbers. We missed our monthly goals twice in a row — in both April and May. I told everyone we shouldn’t worry about it, because this team always shows up when we need them. But we’re in the final stretch to one of the last, official FEC deadlines of this campaign right now, and we are still tracking behind our goal.
If we don’t make up some ground fast we will miss again.
Now, I can’t make heads or tails of it. I don’t know why things have slowed down so much, but if we miss another goal before a critical FEC deadline we are going to have to take a long, hard look at what we’re capable of doing with a reduced budget.
Missing these goals hurts our ability to win — and we _really_ need to win in Arizona. The alternative is... well, let’s just hope we can win.

| | | Good afternoon Friend,
Candace is back, and in the **[latest episode of her hit new _Candace_ podcast](https://email.email.america1stwarroom.com/c/eJw8jsFu8yAQhJ9mfYsFCwHnwOH_G7mHSs2plXKqNmapqYzsAK6Vt68SVb3OjL5vKC1TDDcH9j8gjtEXQAT1DxCv5y3l9Su9PO_ez9tpdzWvaX9v8QkQ623hv-kvpeVEcbqn9th4p4IXumEnrew6ZUVnmtHpoPa0H3TQJA7cBSO9tMRKiaAlk26iQ4FaGHlA1KhtS2jQDMzSWmEvQYAWD09LiXMcSJa6Uc7znNphTs3kxlqX8jjWA_a3ea1re2HA_ih3H4cy29P5DVQfmOqaGdSxjJTZN9n5ZYvTFIuxoMXnQ3JHfjv8CQAA___XxVi9)**, she responds to controversy over her anti-war statements and also breaks down reports that Israel knew about the 10/7 attack in advance.
During her hiatus, Candace went viral for rejecting... the atomic bomb, of all things, so she clapped back about the criticism and took the neocons to task.
[](https://email.email.america1stwarroom.com/c/eJw8jsFu8yAQhJ9mfYsFCwHnwOH_G7mHSs2plXKqNmapqYzsAK6Vt68SVb3OjL5vKC1TDDcH9j8gjtEXQAT1DxCv5y3l9Su9PO_ez9tpdzWvaX9v8QkQ623hv-kvpeVEcbqn9th4p4IXumEnrew6ZUVnmtHpoPa0H3TQJA7cBSO9tMRKiaAlk26iQ4FaGHlA1KhtS2jQDMzSWmEvQYAWD09LiXMcSJa6Uc7znNphTs3kxlqX8jjWA_a3ea1re2HA_ih3H4cy29P5DVQfmOqaGdSxjJTZN9n5ZYvTFIuxoMXnQ3JHfjv8CQAA___XxVi9)
Here’s how Candace broke down her anti-war sentiment:

* “I don’t think we can afford another war,” Candace says.

* Reflecting on the neocons who push war, she says, “There’s no one more unhinged than Lindsay Graham on this topic.”

* Candace uses a humorous analogy to show how absurd it is to say a nuclear bomb saves lives: “That’s literally me to my husband when I buy a dress and tell him I saved money,” Candace says.

“It was a 25% discount, so I saved money... My husband tells me, ‘That’s pretty illogical.’ And he hits me with the fact: No money was saved at all.” The same goes when people say nukes save lives.

**[Candace also breaks down the _Jerusalem Post_ report that Israeli intelligence knew about Hamas’s intentions before 10/7.](https://email.email.america1stwarroom.com/c/eJw8jsFu8yAQhJ9mfYsFCwHnwOH_G7mHSs2plXKqNmapqYzsAK6Vt68SVb3OjL5vKC1TDDcH9j8gjtEXQAT1DxCv5y3l9Su9PO_ez9tpdzWvaX9v8QkQ623hv-kvpeVEcbqn9th4p4IXumEnrew6ZUVnmtHpoPa0H3TQJA7cBSO9tMRKiaAlk26iQ4FaGHlA1KhtS2jQDMzSWmEvQYAWD09LiXMcSJa6Uc7znNphTs3kxlqX8jjWA_a3ea1re2HA_ih3H4cy29P5DVQfmOqaGdSxjJTZN9n5ZYvTFIuxoMXnQ3JHfjv8CQAA___XxVi9)**
| | | | [SUBSCRIBE TO CANDACE'S PODCAST!](https://email.email.america1stwarroom.com/c/eJw8jj9PwzAQRz-NvTWyL8aXDh6gqAxIVGJA6niOL9TIJmn-YOXbo0SI9b3Tux_lIcVudQKfBMAthkkAiPpRANyvJY_LV359OXxcy-Vwt2_5YbNwEgDzOvD_6V-l4kwxbRSfZXB1F5SR7DTqpqlRNVbeHKIxR26Ch84Seo_asLZsVEOd9XWQ0YECo6w-AhgwWBFYsC2zRlToOyWM2v9UlHmMLelpLjSOfZ-rts8yuds8D9M-7CzgXEqp1n6ZF8-b36BR70zpRN-BWr7I0YWhxJTiZFEY9bnHt9SPg98AAAD__0Z8Vq4)
---

“I recall when Charlie Kirk had raised this question [about Israel’s advance warning], and he obviously is remarkably pro-Israel,” Candace says. “They suddenly called him an anti-Semite... Then we learned shortly thereafter that Egypt said they had also warned Israel.

“This makes me uncomfortable because it doesn’t make sense,” Candace continues.

“It doesn’t make sense that they would ignore all of this... It doesn’t make sense when you recognize the conversation that is being had right now, which seems to be that they’ve all already decided on World War III, and we’re all being drafted into it.

It doesn’t make sense when you see the amount of censorship and the attacks that are happening to anyone who stands up against it.

**“I don’t have an issue if you’re pro-Israel,” Candace says. “I’m just saying I don’t want to be involved in your war.”**

**[This new episode of the Candace podcast](https://email.email.america1stwarroom.com/c/eJw8jsFu8yAQhJ9mfYsFCwHnwOH_G7mHSs2plXKqNmapqYzsAK6Vt68SVb3OjL5vKC1TDDcH9j8gjtEXQAT1DxCv5y3l9Su9PO_ez9tpdzWvaX9v8QkQ623hv-kvpeVEcbqn9th4p4IXumEnrew6ZUVnmtHpoPa0H3TQJA7cBSO9tMRKiaAlk26iQ4FaGHlA1KhtS2jQDMzSWmEvQYAWD09LiXMcSJa6Uc7znNphTs3kxlqX8jjWA_a3ea1re2HA_ih3H4cy29P5DVQfmOqaGdSxjJTZN9n5ZYvTFIuxoMXnQ3JHfjv8CQAA___XxVi9)** also covers World War II, Joe Mazzulla praying on his rosary on the side of the court, and Candace’s conversion to Catholicism.

name: Jessica Morse
subject: Happy Juneteenth!
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Jessica Morse for Congress
body:
I was proud to join the Placer County Juneteenth celebration this weekend

| | [](http://go.sparkpostmail1.com/f/a/oCfYYnCeYX33huElERT3ww~~/AAUS1gA~/RgRoVekjP0QdaHR0cHM6Ly9tb3JzZWZvcmNvbmdyZXNzLmNvbS9XA3NwY0IKZm02ZHNm7xE5ClIUZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb21YBAAAAC0~) Peter, Happy Juneteenth! I was proud to join the Placer County Juneteenth celebration this weekend as parents, children, teachers, pastors, politicians, and community leaders, representing a wide racial, religious, and political spectrum, came together to celebrate emancipation from slavery and the progress our nation has made in the last 160 years. Juneteenth also reminds us that tremendous work still needs to be done to fully abolish the legacy of slavery still festering in our country. This celebration stands, sadly, in stark contrast to more divisive messages that have generated national attention for Rocklin over the past few years. Moms for Liberty (a branch of the Proud Boys) won the local school board races, and our local Congressman is spreading messages of hate and division. But our community has been fighting back, protesting the School Board’s book banning intended to eradicate Black history from our schools and pushing back against Kiley’s attempts to vilify inclusion and diversity. In the face of all these acts of hate over the past few years, I am proud to say that activists and community leaders have come together to stand up and push back. A local pastor created a safe haven for the LGBTQ+ community. Local families started a book club to learn about racial diversity. And local teachers continue to teach the writings of Dr. King and his modern disciples – even in the face of book bannings and potential fines. Dr. King admonished us, “When you see something that is not right, you must say something. You must do something. Each of us must do our part to help build the Beloved Community.” I am proud to stand with our community to ensure we teach and learn the lessons from history and work together to secure a more just, fair, and free world than the one we inherited. I know for those leading these fights, this work can feel beleaguering and isolating. Standing up and fighting to hold ground, month after month, is tough work. At the Placer County Juneteenth Celebration, filled with smiles, hugs, music, and dancing, I saw Dr. King’s ‘Beloved Community’ manifested – proving that we can dissolve hatred with love. Dr. King said: “The end is reconciliation; the end is redemption; the end is the creation of the Beloved Community. It is this type of spirit and this type of love that can transform opponents into friends... It is this love which will bring about miracles in the hearts of men.” I am proud to stand with our community to celebrate Juneteenth. Together we are demonstrating the transformative love for our neighbors and together we will bring about miracles. \-- Jessica Morse | | [Chip in 25 now >>](http://go.sparkpostmail1.com/f/a/nMSKYfNkbQ95Bq3PN6rOGw~~/AAUS1gA~)

body:
| | | | | |
---
| Friends,
Over the past 10 months, we have made a case for freedom and stood boldly for our convictions. Unfortunately we came up short on June 18th for the Republican Primary here in the Virginia Seventh District. As a combat veteran, I am reminded that there will always be victories, and losses both great and small. Our character is revealed in our acceptance of both victories and losses with class and honor. While this is not the result many of us were hoping for, I am still grateful for the overwhelming support that my family has received. I am not sending out a list of grievances though there are characteristics of this primary race I would have liked to change if given the opportunity. I want to congratulate Derrick Anderson on his win. I pray that God gives him wisdom and captures his heart. Serving “We The People” is important, however serving the King of Kings is greater in significance.
The GOP is at a cross roads of the future. As a Liberty focused Constitutional Conservative, there are plenty of disagreements I have with other Republicans regarding the role of Government, and your right to live in peace without intrusion. I do not believe that moving the Republican Party to a more moderate platform is the solution, rather we must strengthen our case for the blessings of Political Conservatism. I also believe firmly that we need to bring faith and trust in God back into the Conservative movement. It was the sincere faith of our founding fathers that brought about the establishment of the United States of America and from whom we have received our inalienable rights. I am reminded of the prayer of King Hezekiah.
“Remember now oh Lord, how I have walked before you with faithfulness and a whole heart, and have done what is good in your sight”. 2 Kings 20:3
The call of defending freedom and the foundation of this nation is not over, rather it has intensified. The future of my children, and the children of others are at stake. I do not regret my decision to leave my career and pension behind for this effort. I commit to always being there with you, speaking truth and standing boldly in conviction, regardless of the consequences. At the end of the day, it’s about We the People...not politics.
May God bless you, God bless Virginia, and God bless the United States of America. Fortis Fortuna Adiuvat ⁃ Cameron Hamilton

disclaimer_text: Paid for by Kari Lake for Senate
body:
We can't let the Democrats get away with it.

|
---
Friend,

I'll keep this short. I'm sure you know Arizona is the heart of the 2024 election. The presidency and the Senate majority will be won or lost right here. And with the unprecedented authoritarian action taken by Joe Biden and the Democrats to convict President Trump on phony charges, this election is the most important in American history.

Unfortunately, and I hate to say this, we're losing. As things stand, Arizona will elect a Senator who openly celebrated yesterday's egregious ruling.

Before I ask you for anything, I want you to know that my parents taught me to do a good job, do the right thing, keep my head down, worship God, and not ask anyone for anything.

But when it comes to this country, I can't put my pride first.

**_The reality is I need help. I can't do this alone._**

We're down in the polls, and Ruben Gallego is outraising us big time. **[Thankfully, there are still five months until the election, and if there was ever a time to fight back, it would be right now.](http://links.theusapatriots.com/u/click?_t=e3c9a4cac7f248a39c2a3d920479a441&_m=7950763e89ca4a52b0d2bdf9a41411cd&_e=lXtwMFhXZj0m_O2-JSSebNEHMUJfPtVgIlGDc0nvpj3qjVK4Y2r2K_oexGDcBpgH4TFt4zj_9bpmQ5k8_CvDzeXuRDlyuWJNJvBomBRNzYiDrmE_ttIx6ECSABYZqZz2jJIoh9JSQehqq_10M9WQKnz5AlhTHZcNDBejzu_c3-ARRLB8UE9ERpNZRYtrdBZho-C2ZeQRTXbKFKJDYNQzGsvFU0wc8ypxg_ygfW59ADB7azTvwiPN23NdoRjQX3lgMzr7C-l3V0dhNB1PWF2pmmDzh0b4ebZOxiqxMP0YhW2ySYjPpe7a_1PXVG3iwAMC5Jd0iffwz3uE_Ip0UvMpSbeow8N53m4kCq96lOU1gw-yCU3yVUTFfctIARsLz3rESb_xvTVr7uHaErPY_YYHLw%3D%3D)**

name: Texas Organizing Project
subject: Juneteenth is a beacon of hope and a call to action / Juneteenth es más que un hecho histórico; es una luz de esperanza y un llamado de acción
body:
Lea el boletín en español abajo [#Español]
Reflecting on the 159th anniversary of Juneteenth
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/TSM/TSMTO/1/45640/images/Juneteenth%20break%20chains.jpg]
Juneteenth is more than a historical milestone; it is a beacon of hope and a call to action. As an organization, we have embarked on a movement's journey to challenge the greed and injustice of racial capitalism because for too long the rich and powerful have dictated the rules of the game. We know that the world we inherited was built off the backs of the people they enslaved, the land of indigenous people they stole, and the earth that they continue to exploit. This is not the legacy that we will pass down to our children.
This Juneteenth, let us recommit ourselves to the work of building stronger together a future where every Texan – no matter their race, age, gender, or background – can thrive. Juneteenth represents freedom, resilience, and the power of collective action. It is a reminder that our struggle for workers' rights is deeply intertwined with the broader fight for racial and economic justice. As we celebrate this day, we honor the contributions of Black workers throughout history and recognize the ongoing challenges they face today. It was in 2021 that TOP held its first observance of Juneteenth as a staff holiday, as we commemorated it as #BlackLivesMatter Day, a day for Black joy and resistance. We're proud to be celebrating it as such ever since, as we grow and make strides as a Pro-Black organization.
For us, Juneteenth is a day of respite and reflection, of jubilation and freedom dreaming. That is what liberation looks like to us: finding the possibility in all that seems impossible.
Calling out slumlords and pushing for housing justice in Dallas
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/TSM/TSMTO/1/45640/images/Dallas%20housing%20action%20-%20Meadows%20at%20Ferguson.jpg]
ORGANIZING IN ACTION: TOP teamed up with tenants at the Meadows at Ferguson Apartments in Dallas on Friday to hold a press conference , where tenants publicly spoke out against their landlord, Kcap Texas Portfolio LLC, as their calls to fix dangerous, unlivable conditions have been ignored after severe storms in May caused structural damage to the property.
Watch press coverage of the action. [https://www.wfaa.com/article/news/local/tenants-northeast-dallas-apartment-complex-living-in-dangerous-conditions/287-66182de0-c059-4830-8c56-09256dabe1c2]
To make matters more dire for tenants, only a day after speaking out, the same damaged building deemed unlivable at the complex caught fire, erupted in flames, and burned down. [https://www.cbsnews.com/texas/news/dallas-apartment-building-destroyed-in-2-alarm-fire/]
TOP is working closely with impacted tenants at this time to provide immediate assistance and call attention to the need for housing justice for everyday Dallas residents. We'll continue to shine a light on the hazardous conditions present, because we believe EVERY Texan — no matter their age, race, preferred language, or income level — deserves a safe and affordable place to call home.
To get involved in our fight for these tenants and for housing justice in Dallas, contact Iman Bouzid at ibouzid@organizetexas.org [ibouzid@organizetexas.org] .
THIS SATURDAY: Creating brighter futures and building community power in San Antonio
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/TSM/TSMTO/1/45640/images/MAC%20Bexar%20County%20TOP%20group%20shot.jpg]
Join TOP and San Antonio allies Saturday, June 22 from 11 a.m. - 2 p.m., for a FREE event at the Barbara Jordan Center (2803 E. Commerce St.) dedicated to providing resources, information, and support for individuals seeking expungements to clear their records.
Our Right2Justice team is partnering with Easy Expunctions to guide applicants through the process, offering insights, assistance, and potential opportunity to have your record cleared.
Attendees will gain valuable info and also a sense of community, support, as well as a place to get involved in our fight for mass liberation. Don't miss this opportunity to take a significant step toward a brighter future for yourself or a loved one. Register today and let us help you navigate your path toward expungement.
REGISTER HERE! [https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLScfN9OcDAVx2RV37t4ucGGYx4TI2HEhHm1pmwf8DY3nqyex0A/viewform]
Celebrating Juneteenth with a special film screening and speaker in Houston
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/TSM/TSMTO/1/45640/images/Newsletter%20-%20TEXAS%20USA%20screenshot.jpg]
TOP and Houston Justice on Saturday, June 22 at 2:30 p.m. will host a special Juneteenth event featuring the screening of the documentary TEXAS, USA [https://www.texasusafilm.com/] .
Bring your family and friends to see for yourselves how the future of democracy in the U.S. hinges on our movement's mission to end the right-wing political stranglehold on our state. The documentary features BlackTOP's 2022 midterm election get-out-the-vote program , which made history as the largest single investment in Black voters across Texas EVER, reaching over 1.4 million Black Texans.
After the screening, Terrance "TK" Koontz, TOP’s Culture and Organizational Development Director, will share his compelling life journey to becoming an organizer. TK will discuss the significance of and his dedication to his work with TOP.
RSVP to the documentary screening here [https://secure.ngpvan.com/hpIqtGLu_kCD_qFrnuHebw2] .
TOP Tip: Stream "Stronger Together"
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/TSM/TSMTO/1/45640/images/Updated%20Spotify%20TOP.jpg]
Need a summer organizing anthem? We’ve got you covered. Several TOP staff and members came together to create a song to commemorate and capture the spirit of our journey toward becoming a truly Pro-Black organization.
🎵 Stream TOP’s "Stronger Together " [https://open.spotify.com/track/078Rx6LzFaxHg6gkHUJX1T] 🎵
Español
Reflexionando sobre el 159 aniversario de Juneteenth
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/TSM/TSMTO/1/45640/images/Juneteenth%20break%20chains.jpg]
El Juneteenth es más que un hecho histórico; es una luz de esperanza y un llamado de acción. Como organización, nos hemos embarcado en el viaje de un movimiento para desafiar la codicia y la injusticia del capitalismo racial porque durante demasiado tiempo los ricos y poderosos han dictado las reglas del juego. Sabemos que el mundo que heredamos se construyó en las espaldas de las personas que esclavizaron, sobre la tierra de los pueblos indígenas que robaron y en el suelo que continúan explotando. Éste no es el legado que le dejaremos a nuestros hijos. En TOP, nos dedicamos a construir un estado donde la justicia y la igualdad no sean sólo ideales, sino realidades que todos nosotros podamos vivir.
Este Juneteenth, nos volvemos a comprometer con el trabajo de construir juntos un futuro más fuerte donde cada Tejano, sin importar su raza, edad, género u origen, pueda salir adelante . Juneteenth representa la libertad, la resistencia y el poder de la acción colectiva. Nos recuerda que nuestra lucha por los derechos de los trabajadores está profundamente entrelazada con la lucha por la justicia racial y económica. Al celebrar este día, honramos las contribuciones de los trabajadores Negros a lo largo de la historia y reconocemos los desafíos actuales que enfrentan. Hoy, el Sindicato de Trabajadores TOP se solidariza con todos los trabajadores Negros y Latinos que continúan luchando por salarios dignos y una representación justa. Fue en 2021 que TOP celebró por primera vez Juneteenth como fecha feriado para el personal, ya que lo conmemoramos como el Día #BlackLivesMatter, un día de alegría y resistencia para las comunidades Negras. Estamos orgullosos de celebrarlo como tal desde entonces, a medida que crecemos y avanzamos como organización Pro-Negra.
Para nosotros, Juneteenth será un día de respiro y reflexión, de júbilo y de ensueño de libertad. Así vemos nosotros la liberación: encontrar las posibilidades en todo lo que parece muchas veces imposible.
Denunciando a los malos propietarios y abogando por viviendas de buena calidad en Dallas
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/TSM/TSMTO/1/45640/images/Dallas%20housing%20action%20-%20Meadows%20at%20Ferguson.jpg]
ORGANIZANDO EN ACCIÓN: TOP trabajó con los inquilinos de Meadows at Ferguson Apartments en Dallas el viernes para organizar una conferencia de prensa , donde los inquilinos hablaron públicamente en contra de su propietario, Kcap Texas Portfolio LLC, ya que sus llamados para arreglar condiciones peligrosas e inhabitables han ha sido ignorado después de que severas tormentas en mayo causaran daños estructurales a la propiedad.
Vea la cobertura de prensa de la acción. [https://www.wfaa.com/article/news/local/tenants-northeast-dallas-apartment-complex-living-in-dangerous-conditions/287-66182de0-c059-4830-8c56-09256dabe1c2]
Para empeorar las cosas para los inquilinos, solo un día después de hablar, el mismo edificio dañado considerado inhabitable en el complejo se incendió, estalló en llamas, y se quemó. [https://www.cbsnews.com/texas/news/dallas-apartment-building-destroyed-in-2-alarm-fire/]
TOP está trabajando estrechamente con los inquilinos afectados en este momento para brindar asistencia inmediata y llamar la atención sobre la necesidad de viviendas de buena calidad para los residentes cotidianos de Dallas. Continuaremos arrojando luz sobre las condiciones peligrosas presentes, porque creemos que TODOS Tejanos, sin importar su edad, raza, idioma preferido o nivel de ingresos, merece un lugar seguro y asequible al que llamar hogar.
Para participar en nuestra lucha por estos inquilinos y por la justicia habitacional en Dallas, comuníquese con Iman Bouzid en ibouzid@organizetexas.org [ibouzid@organizetexas.org] .
ESTE SÁBADO: Creando futuros más brillantes y construyendo poder comunitario en San Antonio
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/TSM/TSMTO/1/45640/images/MAC%20Bexar%20County%20TOP%20group%20shot.jpg]
Únase a los aliados de TOP y San Antonio el sábado 22 de junio de 11 a. m. a 2 p. m. para un evento GRATUITO en el Centro Barbara Jordan (2803 E. Commerce St.) dedicado a brindar recursos, información y apoyo a personas que buscan eliminar sus antecedentes penales.
Nuestro equipo de Right 2 Justice se está asociando con Easy Expunctions para guiar a los solicitantes a través del proceso, ofreciendo información, asistencia y oportunidades potenciales para que se borre su historial.
Los asistentes obtendrán información valiosa y también un sentido de comunidad, apoyo y un lugar para involucrarse en nuestra lucha por la liberación masiva. No pierda esta oportunidad de dar un paso importante hacia un futuro mejor para usted o un ser querido. Regístrese hoy y permítanos ayudarle a recorrer su camino hacia la eliminación de antecedentes penales.
¡REGISTRATE AQUÍ! [https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLScfN9OcDAVx2RV37t4ucGGYx4TI2HEhHm1pmwf8DY3nqyex0A/viewform]
Celebramos el Juneteenth con una proyección de película especial y un orador en Houston
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/TSM/TSMTO/1/45640/images/Newsletter%20-%20TEXAS%20USA%20screenshot.jpg]
TOP y Houston Justice el Sábado 22 de Junio a las 2:30 p.m. organizará un evento especial el Juneteenth con la proyección del documental TEXAS, USA [https://www.texasusafilm.com/] .
Traiga a sus familiares y amigos para que vean por sí mismos cómo el futuro de la democracia en los EE. UU. depende de la misión de nuestro movimiento de poner fin al dominio político de derecha sobre nuestro estado. El documental presenta el programa de promoción del voto para las elecciones de mitad de período del 2022 de BlackTOP , que hizo historia como la mayor inversión individual en votantes Negros en todo Texas, llegando a más de 1.4 millones de Tejanos Negros.
Después de la proyección, Terrance "TK" Koontz, director de cultura y desarrollo organizacional de TOP, compartirá su apasionante viaje de vida para convertirse en organizador. TK hablará sobre la importancia y la dedicación de su trabajo con TOP.
Confirma tu asistencia a la proyección del documental aquí. [https://secure.ngpvan.com/hpIqtGLu_kCD_qFrnuHebw2]
Consejos de TOP: Escucha la canción de TOP "Stronger Together"

clean_body: Lea el boletín en español abajo [#Español] Reflecting on the 159th anniversary of Juneteenth [] Juneteenth is more than a historical milestone; it is a beacon of hope and a call to action. As an organization, we have embarked on a movement's journey to challenge the greed and injustice of racial capitalism because for too long the rich and powerful have dictated the rules of the game. We know that the world we inherited was built off the backs of the people they enslaved, the land of indigenous people they stole, and the earth that they continue to exploit. This is not the legacy that we will pass down to our children. This Juneteenth, let us recommit ourselves to the work of building stronger together a future where every Texan – no matter their race, age, gender, or background – can thrive. Juneteenth represents freedom, resilience, and the power of collective action. It is a reminder that our struggle for workers' rights is deeply intertwined with the broader fight for racial and economic justice. As we celebrate this day, we honor the contributions of Black workers throughout history and recognize the ongoing challenges they face today. It was in 2021 that TOP held its first observance of Juneteenth as a staff holiday, as we commemorated it as #BlackLivesMatter Day, a day for Black joy and resistance. We're proud to be celebrating it as such ever since, as we grow and make strides as a Pro-Black organization. For us, Juneteenth is a day of respite and reflection, of jubilation and freedom dreaming. That is what liberation looks like to us: finding the possibility in all that seems impossible. Calling out slumlords and pushing for housing justice in Dallas [] ORGANIZING IN ACTION: TOP teamed up with tenants at the Meadows at Ferguson Apartments in Dallas on Friday to hold a press conference , where tenants publicly spoke out against their landlord, Kcap Texas Portfolio LLC, as their calls to fix dangerous, unlivable conditions have been ignored after severe storms in May caused structural damage to the property. Watch press coverage of the action. [] To make matters more dire for tenants, only a day after speaking out, the same damaged building deemed unlivable at the complex caught fire, erupted in flames, and burned down. [] TOP is working closely with impacted tenants at this time to provide immediate assistance and call attention to the need for housing justice for everyday Dallas residents. We'll continue to shine a light on the hazardous conditions present, because we believe EVERY Texan — no matter their age, race, preferred language, or income level — deserves a safe and affordable place to call home. To get involved in our fight for these tenants and for housing justice in Dallas, contact Iman Bouzid at ibouzid@organizetexas.org [ibouzid@organizetexas.org] . THIS SATURDAY: Creating brighter futures and building community power in San Antonio [] Join TOP and San Antonio allies Saturday, June 22 from 11 a.m. - 2 p.m., for a FREE event at the Barbara Jordan Center (2803 E. Commerce St.) dedicated to providing resources, information, and support for individuals seeking expungements to clear their records. Our Right2Justice team is partnering with Easy Expunctions to guide applicants through the process, offering insights, assistance, and potential opportunity to have your record cleared. Attendees will gain valuable info and also a sense of community, support, as well as a place to get involved in our fight for mass liberation. Don't miss this opportunity to take a significant step toward a brighter future for yourself or a loved one. Register today and let us help you navigate your path toward expungement. REGISTER HERE! [] Celebrating Juneteenth with a special film screening and speaker in Houston [] TOP and Houston Justice on Saturday, June 22 at 2:30 p.m. will host a special Juneteenth event featuring the screening of the documentary TEXAS, USA [] . Bring your family and friends to see for yourselves how the future of democracy in the U.S. hinges on our movement's mission to end the right-wing political stranglehold on our state. The documentary features BlackTOP's 2022 midterm election get-out-the-vote program , which made history as the largest single investment in Black voters across Texas EVER, reaching over 1.4 million Black Texans. After the screening, Terrance "TK" Koontz, TOP’s Culture and Organizational Development Director, will share his compelling life journey to becoming an organizer. TK will discuss the significance of and his dedication to his work with TOP. RSVP to the documentary screening here [] . TOP Tip: Stream "Stronger Together" [] Need a summer organizing anthem? We’ve got you covered. Several TOP staff and members came together to create a song to commemorate and capture the spirit of our journey toward becoming a truly Pro-Black organization. 🎵 Stream TOP’s "Stronger Together " [] 🎵 Español Reflexionando sobre el 159 aniversario de Juneteenth [] El Juneteenth es más que un hecho histórico; es una luz de esperanza y un llamado de acción. Como organización, nos hemos embarcado en el viaje de un movimiento para desafiar la codicia y la injusticia del capitalismo racial porque durante demasiado tiempo los ricos y poderosos han dictado las reglas del juego. Sabemos que el mundo que heredamos se construyó en las espaldas de las personas que esclavizaron, sobre la tierra de los pueblos indígenas que robaron y en el suelo que continúan explotando. Éste no es el legado que le dejaremos a nuestros hijos. En TOP, nos dedicamos a construir un estado donde la justicia y la igualdad no sean sólo ideales, sino realidades que todos nosotros podamos vivir. Este Juneteenth, nos volvemos a comprometer con el trabajo de construir juntos un futuro más fuerte donde cada Tejano, sin importar su raza, edad, género u origen, pueda salir adelante . Juneteenth representa la libertad, la resistencia y el poder de la acción colectiva. Nos recuerda que nuestra lucha por los derechos de los trabajadores está profundamente entrelazada con la lucha por la justicia racial y económica. Al celebrar este día, honramos las contribuciones de los trabajadores Negros a lo largo de la historia y reconocemos los desafíos actuales que enfrentan. Hoy, el Sindicato de Trabajadores TOP se solidariza con todos los trabajadores Negros y Latinos que continúan luchando por salarios dignos y una representación justa. Fue en 2021 que TOP celebró por primera vez Juneteenth como fecha feriado para el personal, ya que lo conmemoramos como el Día #BlackLivesMatter, un día de alegría y resistencia para las comunidades Negras. Estamos orgullosos de celebrarlo como tal desde entonces, a medida que crecemos y avanzamos como organización Pro-Negra. Para nosotros, Juneteenth será un día de respiro y reflexión, de júbilo y de ensueño de libertad. Así vemos nosotros la liberación: encontrar las posibilidades en todo lo que parece muchas veces imposible. Denunciando a los malos propietarios y abogando por viviendas de buena calidad en Dallas [] ORGANIZANDO EN ACCIÓN: TOP trabajó con los inquilinos de Meadows at Ferguson Apartments en Dallas el viernes para organizar una conferencia de prensa , donde los inquilinos hablaron públicamente en contra de su propietario, Kcap Texas Portfolio LLC, ya que sus llamados para arreglar condiciones peligrosas e inhabitables han ha sido ignorado después de que severas tormentas en mayo causaran daños estructurales a la propiedad. Vea la cobertura de prensa de la acción. [] Para empeorar las cosas para los inquilinos, solo un día después de hablar, el mismo edificio dañado considerado inhabitable en el complejo se incendió, estalló en llamas, y se quemó. [] TOP está trabajando estrechamente con los inquilinos afectados en este momento para brindar asistencia inmediata y llamar la atención sobre la necesidad de viviendas de buena calidad para los residentes cotidianos de Dallas. Continuaremos arrojando luz sobre las condiciones peligrosas presentes, porque creemos que TODOS Tejanos, sin importar su edad, raza, idioma preferido o nivel de ingresos, merece un lugar seguro y asequible al que llamar hogar. Para participar en nuestra lucha por estos inquilinos y por la justicia habitacional en Dallas, comuníquese con Iman Bouzid en ibouzid@organizetexas.org [ibouzid@organizetexas.org] . ESTE SÁBADO: Creando futuros más brillantes y construyendo poder comunitario en San Antonio [] Únase a los aliados de TOP y San Antonio el sábado 22 de junio de 11 a. m. a 2 p. m. para un evento GRATUITO en el Centro Barbara Jordan (2803 E. Commerce St.) dedicado a brindar recursos, información y apoyo a personas que buscan eliminar sus antecedentes penales. Nuestro equipo de Right 2 Justice se está asociando con Easy Expunctions para guiar a los solicitantes a través del proceso, ofreciendo información, asistencia y oportunidades potenciales para que se borre su historial. Los asistentes obtendrán información valiosa y también un sentido de comunidad, apoyo y un lugar para involucrarse en nuestra lucha por la liberación masiva. No pierda esta oportunidad de dar un paso importante hacia un futuro mejor para usted o un ser querido. Regístrese hoy y permítanos ayudarle a recorrer su camino hacia la eliminación de antecedentes penales. ¡REGISTRATE AQUÍ! [] Celebramos el Juneteenth con una proyección de película especial y un orador en Houston [] TOP y Houston Justice el Sábado 22 de Junio a las 2:30 p.m. organizará un evento especial el Juneteenth con la proyección del documental TEXAS, USA [] . Traiga a sus familiares y amigos para que vean por sí mismos cómo el futuro de la democracia en los EE. UU. depende de la misión de nuestro movimiento de poner fin al dominio político de derecha sobre nuestro estado. El documental presenta el programa de promoción del voto para las elecciones de mitad de período del 2022 de BlackTOP , que hizo historia como la mayor inversión individual en votantes Negros en todo Texas, llegando a más de 1.4 millones de Tejanos Negros. Después de la proyección, Terrance "TK" Koontz, director de cultura y desarrollo organizacional de TOP, compartirá su apasionante viaje de vida para convertirse en organizador. TK hablará sobre la importancia y la dedicación de su trabajo con TOP. Confirma tu asistencia a la proyección del documental aquí. A Letter to Northern Michigan and the UP, by Tom and Mary Schoeller
We enthusiastically and publicly endorse Dr. Bob Lorinser for Michigan's 1st District Congressional seat. We're lucky to have such an experienced, caring, competent, and hardworking person running to represent Northern Michiganders and Yoopers.
https://secure.actblue.com/donate/about-bob [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/about-bob]
Tom making Mendota Mantels in the UP in front of his off-the-grid home, which he built from mostly reclaimed materials "with lots of help!"
Friends,
Bob Lorinser has exactly the personality, experience, and heart we need Up North to represent us.
He needs our help securing a big win in the Democratic primary on August 6th to face off against Rep. Jack Bergman.
Bergman must be defeated, and Dr. Bob has a much better chance of unseating him in a second run. Your contributions help propel his campaign to victory. [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/about-bob] Can you join me with a gift tonight?
CONTRIBUTE [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/about-bob]
Here's why:
Unlike his challenger, the UP is Bob's permanent home. He's built his career here and raised his family here. He knows our issues. He's been a diplomat, social worker, educator, Medical Director, and leader in public health. He is a gifted family physician.
Bob is as bright as a whip but still very approachable. He's passionate about caring for the needs of our communities and has demonstrated his ability to do just that for years.
He has no hidden agenda and no one he's beholden to. (He does not accept big corporate PAC money.)
What you see is what you get from Dr. Bob. He's a straight shooter.
Bob's honesty, integrity, and passion for people impress you the first time you meet him. He'll gladly and respectfully work with anyone on either side of the aisle—conservatives, moderates, or liberals. He's humble, yet obviously a man of high character.
I'm eager to support Doc because of his policies. He's dedicated to promoting small businesses, labor reform, and livable wages. He's committed to expanding public education, housing, at-risk youth and mental health services, and child care.
He promotes Medicare for all, addressing climate change, protecting our Social Security, and restoring Roe nationwide. He's also passionate about protecting our Democracy from threats from within and outside.
As of April 2024, Bob has raised more in-district funds than Rep. Bergman (who gets much of his funding from PACs and out-state, where he lives part-time.) Dr. Bob also has more endorsements from community leaders and public servants than Bergman.
In many years of watching various political campaigns develop, we haven't seen such a committed, hardworking candidate! Ever. Bob is tough, and he has pledged to run a positive campaign. That's refreshing and rare these days.
If passion, caring, competence, and plain old hard work were the main factors in winning elections, Dr. Bob would be a shoo-in.
Friends, please join me tonight with a contribution. To get the man we deserve in D.C., Bob needs us now.
Thank you,
Tom and Mary Schoeller
Ironwood, MI
